answer: Challenge issue is rate limited to 4 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. An operator running 175 keys therefore pays for 175 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the basalt quota and the tide admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the nectar ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
